fields.title: Article / latest-headline record
fields.description: Raw-passthrough dataset envelope. Every record carries _input/_source/_scrapedAt (and _error/_errorDetail on failures, or _warning on a degraded-but-not-failed extraction). Article-mode records carry headline/articleBody-style fields from ld+json + HTML; latest-mode records (RSS) carry title/link-style fields. Covers both the Russian and English (meduza.io/en/...) editions with the same field shapes.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The exact input value (URL, or 'latest') that produced this record.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: Which extraction strategy emitted this record (S1-html or S2-rss).

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failed extractions (e.g. not_found, http_500, blocked_or_transient).

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

_warning.title: Warning
_warning.description:
Present when the page was reached and parsed but had no extractable article body -- e.g. a /video/ (VideoObject) or /short/ page whose text lives outside the normal

body container. Metadata fields are still populated.

articleBody.title: Article body
articleBody.description: Full article text, reconstructed from div.GeneralMaterial-module-article > p. On English-edition articles that were AI-translated from Russian, the trailing AI-disclosure notice is stripped out. Null for content types (video, short) with no extractable paragraph body.

author.title: Author
author.description: Byline name -- "Meduza" (organization-level attribution) in every sample seen; a distinct individual journalist byline was not observed but the extractor reads whatever name ld+json provides.

image.title: Image
image.description: Lead image, raw ld+json ImageObject (url/height/width) -- passed through as-is, not flattened to a URL string.

inLanguage.title: Language
inLanguage.description: BCP-47 language tag from ld+json (e.g. ru-RU, en-US) -- identifies which edition the article came from.

contentType.title: Content type
contentType.description: The page's schema.org @type: NewsArticle (news/short), Article (feature), or VideoObject (video).

guid.title: GUID
guid.description: RSS item guid, same as link on this feed (latest mode).

teaser.title: Teaser
teaser.description: Short RSS <description> summary, HTML-wrapped -- not the full article body (latest mode).

pubDate.title: Publish date
pubDate.description: RFC-822 publish timestamp as given by the feed (latest mode).

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns across both article and latest-headline records.
